The current repo rate set by the Reserve Bank of India \(RBI\) is 5.25%. [0]

### Current Key Policy Rates

The RBI maintains the following key interest rates as of the latest monetary policy updates:

| Rate Category | Rate Percentage |
| --- | --- |
| Repo Rate | 5.25% |
| Reverse Repo Rate | 3.35% |
| Marginal Standing Facility \(MSF\) Rate | 5.50% |
| Standing Deposit Facility \(SDF\) Rate | 5.00% |
| Bank Rate | 5.50% |

You can check further announcements and details directly via the Reserve Bank of India.

If you would like, I can set up a task to notify you of any upcoming changes or rate reviews by the Reserve Bank of India's Monetary Policy Committee.
